translations.web: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
translations.bsb: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
translations.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
